title: Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1985-11-11
lineage: PCM > DAT > DAW > DSP (see notes) > DataCD (mkw) > HD > SFXP4.5 > CDWave v1.6 > mkwACT0.97b (SHN); taped and transferred by Doug Oade; Fades, track cuts, WAV > SHN conversion & verification done by dwonk; seeded by macdaddy via BT
source: Schoeps CMC441 (FOB, 90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade modSONY PCM-F1

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with top‑notch song selection, though the Althea segment is missing a few seconds.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its outstanding separation, rich low end and crisp highs, indicating a high‑quality soundboard source. The show itself is described as a strong "sleeper" of 1985 with excellent set choices, but one reviewer notes a 3‑4 second gap in Althea that removes about two minutes of music.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance and excellent recording quality yield a high rating, but the noted flaw in Althea and limited number of reviews temper confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean highs and rich lows with excellent instrument separation; however a speed discrepancy is noted and a brief gap in Althea is missing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Song selection described as top‑notch for a 1985 show, making it a strong overall performance despite the Althea issue.
